use default

let limit = 1_000_000
let composite = LIST()

for _ in 0::limit do
    composite.add(false)
od

let factor mut = 2

while factor * factor <= limit do
    if !composite[factor] then
        let multiple mut = factor * factor

        while multiple <= limit do
            composite[multiple] = true
            multiple = multiple + factor
        od
    fi

    factor = factor + 1
od

is_prime(value: int) -> bool => value > 1 /\ !composite[value]

is_magnanimous(value: int) -> bool is
    let digits = "{value}"

    for split in 1..digits.length do
        let left = System.Convert.to_int32(digits[0..split])
        let right = System.Convert.to_int32(digits[split..<0])

        if !is_prime(left + right) then return false fi
    od

    true
si

magnanimous() -> Pipe[int] is
    let candidate mut = 0

    do
        if is_magnanimous(candidate) then
            yield candidate
        fi

        candidate = candidate + 1
    od
si

let terms = magnanimous() |> take(400) |> collect_list()

write_line("the first 45 magnanimous numbers:")

for row in 0::4 do
    let last = if row == 4 then 45 else row * 10 + 10 fi
    let cells = terms[row * 10..last] |> map(term => "{term,6}")

    write_line("  {cells |> join("")}")
od

write_line("")
write_line("the 241st to 250th:")
write_line("  {terms[240..250] |> map(t => "{t,8}") |> join("")}")
